snippet.title: The Trivia Show | Official Trailer | Steam Early Access October 30
snippet.description:
The Trivia Show is coming to Steam Early Access on October 30!
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4857350/The_Trivia_Show/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer

Chaotic multiplayer for up to 8 friends, trapped in a TV show. A question hits the screen, the clock runs, and every wrong answer comes with a price: the room itself turns against you. Think fast, dodge traps and turn the tables.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/6MdFur6Ad9
Developed by Minteeble Games: https://minteeble.com/games/the-trivia-show/

#TheTriviaShow #IndieGame #PartyGame
